## 5.1 A first draft

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An AI tool writes a first draft in a few seconds.
- You check it, and you delete every fact that nobody gave.
- Paste it into Word with Keep Text Only, then use the style Title.
- **Do it:** Ask an AI chat for a library notice in three lines. Is every fact true?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/draft-flow.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · A first draft

a) Who is responsible for the words in an AI draft?
b) Which paste option takes only the text?
c) The draft says "Free coffee for all." Nobody said this. What do you do?

::: {.answer}
a) you
b) Keep Text Only
c) Delete it.
:::

## 5.2 A summary

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A summary keeps only the main points of a long text.
- A summary can drop a point or change a number.
- So you compare every point with the original text.
- **Do it:** In Word AI Lab, choose Sum up. Which part of the answer is wrong?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/summary-check.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 2 · Summaries

a) The summary says 3 pm, and the memo says 5 pm. Which is right?
b) What does a summary keep?
c) Which AI job helps with a 6-page report before a meeting?

::: {.answer}
a) the memo: 5 pm
b) only the main points
c) a summary
:::

## 5.3 Rewrite in another tone

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A rewrite says the same thing in other words.
- A formal tone is for people you do not know, and a friendly tone is for people you know.
- The facts must stay the same after a rewrite.
- **Do it:** Rewrite "Meeting moved to 10 am." in a friendly tone. Is the time still 10 am?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/rewrite-tone.png)
:::
::::

## Example · A polite answer

A colleague wrote to a customer: "Your order is late. It comes in 2 days. Sorry."
**How does Huda make it polite and keep the facts?**

::: {.reveal}
1. She asks: "Rewrite in a polite, formal tone for a customer."
2. The AI writes: "Dear Mr Haddad, we are sorry: your order will arrive two days late."
3. She checks the facts: **late, two days**. They are the same.
:::

## Try it 3 · Rewrite

a) Which tone fits a customer you have never met?
b) What do you do when the rewrite adds a 20 % discount that nobody promised?
c) What must stay the same after a rewrite?

::: {.answer}
a) formal
b) Delete the promise.
c) the facts
:::

## 5.4 Translate and check

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Word translates with Review › Translate.
- A machine translation is fast, but it can be wrong.
- Check the days, dates, numbers, names and the meaning.
- **Do it:** Translate "The library closes at 2 pm on Wednesday." into Arabic. Are the day and time right?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/translate-check.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 4 · Translate

a) Where is Translate in Word?
b) The memo says Thursday, but the Arabic says الثلاثاء. Is it right?
c) Should you paste a work contract into a free online translator?

::: {.answer}
a) Review › Translate
b) No, الثلاثاء is Tuesday.
c) No, because it is private.
:::

## Try it 5 · Huda checks (harder)

The facts: the AI summary says the meeting is on Monday, but the report says Tuesday. The AI draft adds "Free coffee for all staff."

a) Which day is the meeting?
b) What does Huda do with "Free coffee for all staff"?
c) What is the last step before Huda uses any AI text?

::: {.answer}
a) Tuesday, as the report says
b) She deletes it.
c) She checks it.
:::

## Summary

- AI can draft, summarize, rewrite and translate a Word document.
- You paste with Keep Text Only and format with styles.
- You compare a summary with the original text.
- A rewrite changes the words and the tone, but never the facts.
- You check days, dates, numbers and names in a translation.
